{{Top|leg}}
'''Darry''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. When beginning his career as a bounty hunter, he coveted owning a [[Model AXM-50 "Blast and Smash"]]. Once he acquired it, Darry enjoyed how it made crowds scatter when they saw him carrying it. On the entry for the [[SC-4 blaster pistol]] in the Datalog, Darry related a story about a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] they knew who was gifted one of the weapons for services rendered. After the hunter took down the wrong target with it, he was arrested by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and forced to work for them. After retiring, Darry opened a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Over the bar hung his "Blast and Smash" to discourage any firefights in his bar.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
